page: Amazon Web Services r8ib.32xlarge is an eighth-generation memory-optimized instance operating on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. Powered by an Intel x86_64 processor clocked at 3.9 GHz, the server delivers 128 virtual CPUs derived from 64 dedicated physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The instance is provisioned with 1024.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU allocation that provides 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

Network infrastructure on the r8ib.32xlarge provides a 133 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating large volumes of egress and ingress traffic. The server does not bundle local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for persistent data layers. Furthermore, the configuration does not incorporate discrete graphics processing units, prioritizing high-capacity memory registers and raw networking throughput over GPU-based acceleration.

The instance achieves qualitative cost efficiency for memory-dominated workloads by coupling high memory density directly with dedicated compute capacity and advanced network throughput. This configuration eliminates expenses tied to idle GPU silicon or unused local disks. The r8ib.32xlarge is suited for memory-bound applications, including distributed in-memory data grids, large enterprise relational databases, real-time analytics engines, and high-throughput caching tiers.
description: Amazon Web Services r8ib.32xlarge is an eighth-generation memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. Driven by an Intel x86_64 architecture operating at 3.9 GHz, it features 128 virtual CPUs provisioned from 64 dedicated physical cores with two threads per core. The server is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, sustaining an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio that yields 8.0 GB of memory per core. Network operations are supported by a substantial 133 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance includes neither local instance storage nor discrete hardware GPUs, directing persistent storage operations to remote cloud storage. Qualitatively, its resource footprint delivers density for memory-bound applications without the overhead of unused accelerator hardware. The r8ib.32xlarge is structured for large-scale memory-intensive workloads, such as distributed in-memory databases, memory-resident data analytics engines, enterprise relational database management systems, and high-throughput real-time data processing architectures.
